cycles.programme: Accountant Officer — Union Territory Child Protection Society
cycles.statusNote: Walk-in interview announced for 8 October at 10:00. No separate application deadline or opening date printed; founder review pending.
cycles.scopeLabel: 1 contract Accountant Officer post; initial term one year; one walk-in application and interview
cycles.outcome: 1 Accountant Officer contract post with UTCPS, initially for one year. Monthly remuneration ₹36,370; renewal and appointment remain subject to authority decision.
cycles.qualifications: Notice offers retired Accounts Officer or Section Officer route, or B.Com. with at least 60% from a recognised university, and states two years' Accounts Officer/Section Officer experience. How experience applies across both alternatives needs founder confirmation. Ability to use accounting software, MS Office and internet is required. Age 25–62; form asks age on date of advertisement.
cycles.citizenshipRule: No nationality condition is stated in this three-page notice. Whether foreign citizens may attend selection or receive a Chandigarh Administration contract appointment needs official confirmation.
cycles.residenceRule: No domicile or residence condition is stated. Attendance at the Chandigarh walk-in is a venue requirement, not proof of local residence eligibility.
selectionStages: Bring completed application, photo, resume, self-attested qualification and experience copies, plus originals
Walk-in interview on 8 October 2026 at 10:00 at 5th Floor, New Secretariat, Sector 9, Chandigarh
Document checks and authority appointment decision
cycles.fee: No fee is stated in the notice; verify before assuming free application.

manualChecks.text: Confirm whether foreign citizens can apply for the UTCPS contract; the notice gives no nationality condition (page 1).
Verify retired officer or B.Com. 60% route and whether two years' Accounts/Section Officer experience applies to both routes; notice table is ambiguous (page 1).
Verify age 25–62 and reference date; application form asks age on date of advertisement, while dated index row says 22 September 2026 (pages 1–2).
Bring completed form, original documents and self-attested copies to 8 October walk-in. Notice names no language examination or proficiency level (page 1).
Contract appointment conditions and foreign-citizen permission require authority verification; selection may be cancelled by competent authority (page 1).
